title: Send email with Tinysend
description: Send transactional email from a Tinysend mailbox on tinysend.com or your own domain, with an idempotency key so a retry sends once.

environment.name: TINYSEND_API_KEY
environment.description: The Tinysend API key, which looks like sk_..., comes from app.tinysend.com/account/tokens. Keep it server-side.

environment.name: TINYSEND_FROM
environment.description: The default sender is one of your Tinysend mailboxes, for example hello@yourdomain.com. A request can name another mailbox in its from field.

environment.name: TINYSEND_FUNCTION_TOKEN
environment.description: Callers send this random token as Authorization: Bearer <token>. It must be at least 32 characters long, and openssl rand -hex 32 generates one. The function requires it because Neon Function URLs are public.

operations.title: Send an email
operations.description: POST a JSON body with to, subject, and text or html. The body can also set from, reply_to, tag and metadata. With an Idempotency-Key header, a retry returns the first send instead of sending again.
